content: अपवृज् €7 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To avert, destroy, dissipate; तमः, शत्रुम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 To tear off, pull out, take out. .²3 To conclude, finish, absolve. . --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To leave, quit, abandon, avoid; दूरापवर्जितच्छत्रैः शिरोभिः <ls>R. 17. 79</ls> keeping the umbrellas at a (great) distance; त्वयात्महस्तेन मही मदच्युता मतङ्गजेन स्रगिवापवर्जिता <ls>Ki. 1. 29</ls> abandoned, left, lost. .²2 To let go, drop down, throw, pour; सुमनसो दिव्याः खेचरैरपवर्जिता <ls>Bhāg.</ls>; करयुग्मपद्ममुकुलापवर्जितैः <ls>Śi. 13. 37</ls>. .²3 To abandon, release, discharge, pay off (as debt <ab>&c.</ab>); absolve oneself from, fulfil, make good (as a promise). .²4 To sever, separate, cut off; भल्लापवर्जितैस्तेषां शिरोभिः (महीं तस्तार) <ls>R. 4. 63</ls>; <ls>Ki. 17. 58</ls> severed or cut off by arrows; इमान्यमूनीत्यपवर्जिते शनैः <ls>Ki. 8. 20</ls> plucked. .²5 To overturn; empty; घटेऽपवर्जिते <ls>Y. 3. 300</ls>. .²6 To honour, respect, esteem. .²7 To give, bestow, grant, present; अपवर्जितं कोशजातम् <ls>Dk. 36</ls>; दक्षिणामपवर्ज्य <ls>Mb.</ls>; अपवर्जितौ वरौ <ls>Rām.</ls>
